_about: Cart feel for the mobile web game (mobile/), copied from the Godot cart scene (scenes/cart/cart.tscn) and floor materials (assets/physics/*.tres) by tools/export_cart_tuning.gd. Do not edit by hand: change the cart in the Godot editor and export again. Units: kg, N, m/s, rad, N*m.
_gears: [N per hand, top walking speed m/s]. Desktop picks one with the scroll wheel; mobile thumbs sweep from the first to the last.
_pull_ratio: Pulling (leaning back) is this much stronger than pushing.
_brake: Stopping a rolling cart: the body plants, the arms straighten (up to arm_reach m) and hold harder the further they stretch (brake_spring N/m + brake_damping N per m/s, capped at brake_max N per hand).
_tip: Godot: hold W/S past tip_delay s and the lean keeps growing at tip_rate rad/s; past let_go_pitch rad the hands slip off and the cart falls over.
